description: Sheikh Ladies & Gents Tailors, Aminabad, Lucknow. 22 years in tailoring, my father started the shop. We stitch blouses, salwar suits, kurtas, lehenga, sherwani and do all alterations. Chikankari work kurtas also available on order. Fitting trial given before final stitching for wedding orders. Normal orders ready in 5-7 days, urgent 2 days with extra charge. Shop open 11am to 9pm, Friday half day. Home measurement visit possible for ladies within Lucknow on appointment.
